title: Sicupira Family Associate Professor of Business Administration
bio: How Digital Integration Is Reconfiguring Value Chains My latest Harvard Business Review article examines how advances in APIs, hyperspecialized service providers, and digital orchestration are transforming global value chains. Drawing on a decade of research, I explore how companies from cloud kitchens to logistics platforms are leveraging cross-organizational integration to unlock agility, scalability, and innovation—and what strategies business leaders can adopt to thrive in this new landscape.

He teaches courses related to technology and operations management in the MBA, executive, and doctoral programs. Before joining HBS, he was an associate professor in the Kellogg School of Management.
